newsitem.title: USA: Boral to divest U.S. unit, Boral Gypsum.
newsitem.headline: Boral to divest U.S. unit, Boral Gypsum.

text.p: Boral Industries Inc, a subsidiary of Boral Ltd, said Thursday it will divest its unit Boral Gypsum Inc of Nashville, Arkansas.
The wallboard manufacturing plant had 1996 sales of $81 million, Boral said.

The company said Boral Gypsum lacked the "potential to hold a leading position in the U.S. plasterboard market under Boral's stewardship" and said it would continue to refocus its business by shedding non-core assets.
The company said that over the last two years it has divested 18 operations.
The 18 divestments have realized $324 million Australian dollars, which Boral said has been invested in acquisitions including the Bickerstaff and Isenhour brick businesses.
Boral said the acquisitions have made it the largest U.S. producer of bricks.
